answer_1.quote: Large and Very Large Language Models (LLMs/VLLMs) have set a new standard for natural language generation (NLG)... Our contributions are ... (i) method and code for collecting long-input data for D2T generation, along with a dataset of 537 long inputs; (ii) English and Irish system outputs for these 537 inputs, as well as human-written texts for a subset of 21 inputs...
datasets: Long-input DBpedia D2T dataset (537 triple sets)
answer_1.outputs: System-generated English and Irish texts for the 537 DBpedia triple sets, plus human-written reference texts for 21 inputs

answer_2.quote: For our analysis, we consider only the output texts used in the evaluation... We use the following four metrics as well as the average text length in words: (i) The N-Gram Diversity score... (ii) CompRate... (iii) SelfRep-4... (iv) ChamDist...

answer_3.quote: For assessing the quality of the different outputs, we ran and averaged the scores assigned by two different LLMs, GPT-o3 and Claude-sonnet-3.7, two of the best models currently available.
methods: LLM-as-judge scoring using a structured prompt evaluating four dimensions

answer_4.quote: Due to the cost and difficulty of performing an human evaluation on such a dataset, the texts are only assessed using an LLM-as-judge approach. ... a human assessment of the outputs (and of the LLM judgments) in both languages would be needed to draw more solid conclusions.
